qualificationCommands.command: node --input-type=module -e "import{execFileSync}from'node:child_process';import{copyFileSync,mkdirSync,readdirSync,rmSync}from'node:fs';const repo='Nespeche/finscope-analytics';const tag='v0.21.20-B17-completed';const out='.finscope-release';rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});const release=JSON.parse(execFileSync('gh',['api','repos/'+repo+'/releases/tags/'+tag],{encoding:'utf8'}));if(release.draft||release.prerelease||release.tag_name!==tag)throw new Error('RELEASE_NOT_PUBLISHED_STABLE');const names=release.assets.map((asset)=>asset.name);const fixed=['FS_v0.21.20_B17_completed.zip','FS_v0.21.20_B17_completed.zip.sha256','GITHUB_RELEASE_HANDOFF.json','PROMPT_IMPLEMENTACION_B18.md'];const evidence=names.filter((name)=>name.startsWith('FinScope_B17_release_evidence_')&&name.endsWith('.json'));if(names.length!==5||new Set(names).size!==5||fixed.some((name)=>!names.includes(name))||evidence.length!==1)throw new Error('RELEASE_ASSET_SET_INVALID:'+JSON.stringify(names));execFileSync('gh',['release','download',tag,'--repo',repo,'--dir',out,'--clobber'],{stdio:'inherit'});const downloaded=readdirSync(out);if(!fixed.every((name)=>downloaded.includes(name))||!downloaded.includes(evidence[0]))throw new Error('RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE');copyFileSync(out+'/'+evidence[0],out+'/FinScope_B17_release_evidence_'+process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID+'.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({result:'PASS',releaseId:release.id,tag,commit:'b7a7c280ef4f46078adf8f8cb3f2f323e25c5c3f',assets:names.sort(),sourceEvidence:evidence[0]}));"

node --input-type=module -e "import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';const out='.finscope-release';const sha=(path)=>createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');const h=JSON.parse(readFileSync(out+'/GITHUB_RELEASE_HANDOFF.json','utf8'));if(h.tag!=='v0.21.20-B17-completed'||h.commitSha!=='b7a7c280ef4f46078adf8f8cb3f2f323e25c5c3f'||h.assets.length!==4)throw new Error('PUBLISHED_HANDOFF_IDENTITY_INVALID');for(const asset of h.assets){if(sha(out+'/'+asset.name)!==asset.sha256)throw new Error('PUBLISHED_ASSET_HASH_MISMATCH:'+asset.name);}const evidenceAsset=h.assets.find((asset)=>asset.name.startsWith('FinScope_B17_release_evidence_')&&asset.name.endsWith('.json'));if(!evidenceAsset)throw new Error('PUBLISHED_EVIDENCE_MISSING');const evidence=JSON.parse(readFileSync(out+'/'+evidenceAsset.name,'utf8'));if(evidence.result!=='PASS'||evidence.tag!==h.tag||evidence.commitSha!==h.commitSha||evidence.zipSha256!=='d212c78871b8d6f53b26bfcb43c9a272cabcf043218dedec77439db7e399049d'||evidence.specify.count!==19||evidence.specify.sha256!=='e06c8fbab523b824c144bb22b616001a3a4e810bb9daaa793e84d5cbb77c2c09'||evidence.completedBatchId!=='B17'||evidence.nextBatchId!=='B18')throw new Error('PUBLISHED_EVIDENCE_INVALID');if(h.baselineState.activeBatchId!=='B18'||h.baselineState.nextAuthorizedBatchId!=='B18'||h.baselineState.completedTasksThrough!=='T076'||h.baselineState.convergenceAuthorized!==false)throw new Error('PUBLISHED_STATE_INVALID');console.log(JSON.stringify({result:'PASS',releaseId:h.releaseId,releaseRunId:h.releaseRunId,evidence:evidenceAsset.name,zipSha256:evidence.zipSha256,assets:h.assets.map((asset)=>({name:asset.name,sha256:asset.sha256}))}));"
